title: Luxurious Creamy Turkish Potatoes Pide
description: A creamy and comforting Turkish dish featuring new potatoes, perfect for a post-workout meal, wrapped in a lotus leaf for a unique touch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine sliced new potatoes, kombu cold extract, salt, black pepper, and dried thyme, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together turkish cheese, plain greek yogurt, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Add the potato mixture to the cheese mixture and stir until the potatoes are well coated.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the potato mixture for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a separate bowl, whisk together whole wheat flour and a pinch of salt.
Gradually add the flour mixture to the potato mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a portion of the potato mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a pide shape and wrap each pide in a lotus leaf wrap.
Place the pides on a baking sheet and bake for 25 minutes, or until the dough is golden brown.
